text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It was indeed a formidable foe. Despite 
its appearance, it is a terrifying stuffed 
animal, yes...
choice_data_list: I-If that's how it's gonna be...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't... I know all too well. If you 
rematch now, you'll sink straight to the 
bottom of the mire.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My money ran away from home, and my 
roommate yelled at me... Nothing good ever 
happens!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, the day will come when I shall don 
this mask once more. Believing in that 
day, I step down from the ring for now, 
yes!"
It ended in a disappointing result...
